headline: Virbac to Acquire Axiota Animal Health for US$65 Million in Revenue Footprint
summary: Virbac has agreed to acquire US-based Axiota Animal Health to expand its global footprint in innovative cattle health solutions, particularly within the US ruminant market.
why: Strategic acquisitions in specialized healthcare and veterinary sectors allow multinational firms to expand product portfolios and geographic reach.

impacts.name: Virbac
impacts.why: The company is expanding its operations through a strategic acquisition.
